A PRINTED SLOT WITH NO ROW REDS, TIED TO THE BAR (the chair, 2026-11-20 18:52 UTC): a slot (surface | printed position) with no entry for a size reds where ONE sentence of it prints in 15 or more of the size's 150 places (two thirds of the 15% bar; ceil(n x 0.10)); where its commonest sentence prints in 8 to 14 of 150 it is listed as watch, not red; below that it is neither. --write registers every slot printed in MIN_PLACES or more places of a size over the corpus `corpus` names. A CEILING ONLY TIGHTENS: an entry's ceiling bounds `meet` (TOP share where the slot prints at most 1.5 sentences a place, SEEN otherwise; `by` names which); --write adds entries and retires stale ones by name into `retired` and never raises a ceiling; --tighten (the chair's door) lowers a ceiling loose on both readings and never raises one. Nothing edits this file by hand. Held by tests/lint/samenessCensus.walker.test.js and `node scripts/sameness-census.mjs --check`.

identity._rule: A slot is keyed `<surface> | <position>`: the surface, and where the page prints the line whatever it says (the renderer's position: named components and each element's place among its siblings, a keyed list item `*`; the session sheet's key path). Every wording printed at one position is one slot, whichever stored path holds it (the chair, 2026-11-20: a pool's lines are one slot). The stored paths are attribution (`paths`): those that hold the printed sentence word for word, else those of the longest stored sentence it contains.
